scriptName.description: The name of the script defined on your package.json you'd like to run.

async.description:
A boolean value representing whether or not this script needs to be run asynchronously and not block the test.
Ex. The script to run storybook.

title:
A spec representing an NPM script to be run by {@link Es#Package}.

To denote in a string that the script should be async, simply add ' async'.
For example, 'build' is scriptName 'build' not async, and 'build async' is scriptName 'build' and async true.
name: Es.PackageNpmScriptSpec
